discussion_comments.comment_body: I’m keeping the fail-if-present behavior. GitHub artifact jobs run on fresh runners, while local callers explicitly choose `StageDir`; silently deleting or overwriting a caller-provided directory would be less safe. A repeated local invocation should use a new staging path or remove the old one deliberately, so this is not a release rerun blocker.
